description: Delete a custom-field definition from the organization. If the field is mandatory and already has values stored on entities the service will reject the delete with a clear reason. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set. Admin role required.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

custom_field_id.description: Id of the custom field definition to delete.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: delete_custom_field
